parameters.query:
INSERT INTO report_raw_ghl_appointments (appointment_id, contact_id, calendar_id, assigned_user_id, location_id, title, status, start_at, end_at, notes, payload_json, batch_id, loaded_at)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, $10, $11::jsonb, $12, $13::timestamptz
ON CONFLICT (appointment_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  start_at = EXCLUDED.start_at,
  end_at = EXCLUDED.end_at,
  notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
  payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json,
  loaded_at = NOW()

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, workflow: 'LT - GHL Daily Appointments Ingest', status: 'completed' } }];
